    CORPORATE PROFILE

    華潤醫藥集團有限公司
             （股份代號：3320）
                       是中       China Resources Pharmaceutical Group Limited (stock code: 3320) is
    國領先的綜合醫藥公司，業務範疇覆蓋醫藥及        a leading integrated pharmaceutical company in China. Our business
    保健產品的生產、分銷及零售。本集團成立於        spans across manufacturing, distribution and retail of pharmaceutical and
    二零零七年，現已發展成中國前五大醫藥製造        healthcare products. Since the establishment in 2007, the Group has
    商兼中國前三大醫藥產品分銷商
                 （按收益） 。        developed into one of the fifth largest pharmaceutical manufacturers and the
                                one of the third largest pharmaceutical distributors (by revenue) in China.

    本公司於二零一六年十月在香港成功完成全球        In October 2016, the Company successfully completed its global offering
    發售。我們的製造業務涵蓋研發、生產及銷售        in Hong Kong. Our manufacturing business encompasses the research
    醫藥產品。我們生產615種藥品，產品組合包       and development, manufacturing and sale of pharmaceutical products. We
    括化學藥品、中藥、生物製劑以及營養保健         manufacture 615 products comprising chemical drugs, Chinese medicines
    品，覆蓋廣泛治療領域，包括心血管、消化         and biopharmaceutical drugs as well as nutritional and healthcare products,
    道和新陳代謝、大容量靜脈注射液、兒科、         covering a wide range of therapeutic areas including cardiovascular,
    呼吸系統等。此外，我們擁有「999」、「東阿阿     alimentary tract and metabolism, large-volume IV infusion, pediatrics,
    膠」、「雙鶴」、「紫竹」、「江中」及「博雅」等多個   respiratory system, etc. Moreover, we own a range of famous brands,
    馳名品牌，業務覆蓋感冒、胃腸、皮膚、兒         such as “999”, “Dong-E-E-Jiao”, “Double Crane”, “Zizhu”, “Jiangzhong”,
    科、骨科、血製品等品類，未來將積極向健康        and “Boya”, covering therapeutic areas including cold, gastroenterology,
    管理、慢病管理產品延伸，滿足中國家庭從預        dermatology, pediatrics, orthopedics, blood products, among others. In
    防、保健、治療、康復，全週期、多層次的健        future, we will actively expand into health management and products for
    康需求。                        chronic disease management to meet the full-cycle and multi-dimensional
                                healthcare needs of Chinese households from prevention, healthcare,
                                therapy to recovery.

    我們視研發創新為長期發展的重要驅動力，持        We regard R&D and product innovation as important drivers for long-term
    續加大研發投入，具有三個獲國家認證的工程        growth and consistently increase the investment in R&D activities. We
    技術研究中心、四個獲國家認證的企業技術中        operate 3 State-certified engineering technology research centers, 4
    心，以及20個獲省市級認證的研究中心，研        State-certified enterprise technology centers and 20 provincially-accredited
    發人員近1,300名。                 research centers, with a R&D team comprising close to 1,300 staff
                                members.

    憑藉我們全面的產品供應及廣泛的分銷網路，        Leveraging our comprehensive product supply and wide distribution
    我們向中國的醫院及其他醫療機構直接分銷產        networks, we directly distribute products to hospitals and other medical
    品。我們經營著一個由208個物流中心構成的       institutions across the country. We operate a national distribution network
    全國性分銷網路，戰略性覆蓋中國28個省、        comprising 208 logistics centers strategically across 28 provinces,
    直轄市及自治區，客戶數量超13萬家，其中        municipalities and autonomous regions in China, with over 130,000 clients,
    包括二、三級醫院9,421家，基層醫療機構客      including 9,421 second- and third-class hospitals and around 70,000
    戶近七萬家。另外，我們經營中國最大零售         primary medical institutional clients. In addition, we operate one of the
    藥房網絡之一，我們以「華潤堂」和「德信行」等      largest retail pharmacy networks in China, comprising 801 pharmacies
    全國或地區性的優質品牌來經營801家零售藥       under national or regional premium brands – “CR Care(華潤堂)” and “Teck
    房，其中包括DTP專業藥房211家（含「雙通道」    Soon Hong(德信行)”, including 211 DTP specialty pharmacies (including 87
    藥店87家）

內部監控及風險管理               INTERNAL CONTROL AND RISK MANAGEMENT

董事會明白，董事會須負責維持充分的風險管    The Board acknowledges that it is the responsibility of the Board for
理及內部監控制度，以保障股東的投資及本公    maintaining an adequate risk management and internal control systems to
司的資產，並每年審閱該制度的有效性。風險    safeguard shareholder investments and Company assets and reviewing the
管理及內部監控系統可對重大錯誤陳述或損失    effectiveness of such systems on an annual basis. The risk management
提供合理而非絕對的保證，並旨在管理而非消    and internal control systems can provide reasonable and not absolute
除在達致業務目標的過程中出現的失敗風險。    assurance against material misstatement or loss and are designed to
                        manage rather than eliminate the risk of failure in the process of attaining
                        business objectives.

本集團已建立全面的風險管理及內部控制系     The Group has established a comprehensive risk management and
統，並極為重視其製藥、醫藥分銷及藥品零售    internal control system, and devoted significant attention to internal
業務的內部控制措施。其已採取嚴格的內部控    control measures of its pharmaceutical manufacturing, pharmaceutical
制措施及經營程式，以監管從研發到生產、分    distribution and pharmaceutical retail businesses. It has adopted stringent
銷及零售的醫藥價值鏈各個環節。本集團內部    internal control measures and operating procedures to regulate all stages
控制系統根據相關行業及管理標準（包括GMP   of its pharmaceutical value chain, from research and development to
及GSP要求）設計。本集團定期實施內部控制   manufacturing, distribution and retail. The Group’s internal control system
審計、內部風險管理及除錯防錯方面的各項程    is designed according to relevant industrial and management standards,
序。                      including the GMP and GSP requirements. The Group implements the
                        procedures for periodic internal control audit, internal risk management, and
                        error correction and prevention on a regular basis.

          認。                                       recognised in the statement of profit or loss.

35. 以股份為基礎的付款                           35. SHARE-BASED PAYMENTS
   本集團之附屬公司江中製藥經營有限股                         Jiangzhong Pharmaceutical, a subsidiary of the Group, operates a
   份獎勵計劃（
        「該計劃」），旨在向對江中                        restricted share incentive scheme (the “Scheme”) for the purpose

   已抵押存款。該等金融工具的主要目的               pledged deposits. The main purpose of these financial instruments

   產生。
